name: Impervious Heavyback
description: Raises the falchion over the head like a hawk's crest, covering the brow while the eyes track the opponent.

name: Vanishing Bulkblade
description: Rocks the weight forward onto the front foot in the instant before the stoop begins.

name: Punishing Weightbelly
description: Falls in a straight stoop with the falchion's weighted end leading toward the opponent's collarbone.

name: Murk Cleaverbelly
description: Pulls out of a stoop with the flat turned up to catch a swift counter.

name: Rumblestump
description: Opens the arms wide and cuts at the full length of the falchion with a pulse of field behind it.

name: Murk Clipedge
description: Rises on the toes into a parry that lifts the opponent's blade off its line like an updraft.

name: Unseen Hew
description: Circles the opponent at a hawk's distance, shortening the ring until the stoop is within reach.

name: Hackscourge
description: Stoops with the xiantian field pressed into the blade, cleaving through the guard and the arm behind it.

name: Chunkblink
description: Springs out of the stoop onto a distant footing and settles into the perch guard before the answer comes.

name: Iron Thickspine
description: Drops the full xiantian field behind the clipped point and drives it through a guard and the body behind it.

name: Obdurate Chopblade
description: Faces the opponent square, as two courts opposed, with the blade held between them at the centre line.

name: Flintlike Nubtip
description: Turns the opponent's first cut aside on the near edge of the court line.

name: Hellish Cleft
description: Answers the turned cut with a chop from the far side, the second cut following the first at once.

name: Hashvortex
description: Shifts two steps along the court line so the opposing blade lands behind the moving body.

name: Whackhavoc
description: Counts the opponent's rhythm aloud in the mind and beats the falchion onto the weak count.

name: Torrent Nubtip
description: Sets a line of qi along the court's centre so a blow crossing it is thrown wide.

name: Iron Hack
description: Hacks once to turn and once to answer, the two cuts running on the same line.

name: Hoarfrost Falchhilt
description: Presses the swell onto the opposing blade across the court line and pins it in place.

name: Granite Hash
description: Steps through the opponent's court line to stand on the far side and cut from behind the guard.

name: Nubvalor
description: Turns a heavy cut with the flat and lets the held field fall onto the opponent in an answering cleave.

name: Hackvalor
description: Overturns the opposing blade by pressing on both the court lines at once, leaving the guard broken.

name: Devastating Sanguine Chunk
description: Lands two falchion cuts in the same instant, one on each side of the court line, through a field-hardened guard.

name: Aegisnub
description: Stands low at the bank of the bend with the blade angled to meet water coming from the side.

name: Cleftglare
description: Slips along the current of the opponent's attack, moving with it instead of against it.

name: Sanguine Falchhilt
description: Returns a hack along the bend of a deflected cut, striking the opponent where the cut ended.

name: Equipoise Wedgetip
description: Turns the falchion in a small eddy that swallows a thrust and throws it aside.

name: Whack Scourge
description: Cuts along a winding line that bends round the opponent's guard before landing on the open flank.

name: Fastening Clipedge
description: Holds the blade at the elbow of the bend, pinning the opponent's weapon against the ground.

name: Gnashing Chunk
description: Lets a flood of qi follow the falchion along each curve of its path, cutting with growing weight.

name: Cleft Ruin
description: Throws the blade out in a curve and cleaves back across from behind the opponent's guard.

name: Iron Whack
description: Cuts under the bank of the opponent's guard with a field-edged blade, driving clean through armor to the body.

name: Hoarfrost Wedgetip
description: Seats the stance on a held breath so that the body and the blade stand as a single mass.

name: Unconquered Thickspine
description: Catches a cut in the hollow of the curved edge and holds it for one beat.

name: Siltstump
description: Steps back a pace behind the caught blow without letting the guard open.

name: Stumphavoc
description: Lets the pressure of the caught cut build in the arm before releasing it in a chop.

name: Unconquered Heavyback
description: Rolls the caught weapon along the rim of the curved blade until it leaves the guard.

name: Impenetrable Cleaverbelly
description: Fills the hollow of the guard with the qi field so a blow lands against a cushion.

name: Booming Weightbelly
description: Releases the weight gathered by the hollow in an overhead chop on the opponent's guard.

name: Unrelenting Chopblade
description: Pools the force of a strong blow in the curve of the falchion and sends part of it back to the attacker.

name: Ironnubtip
description: Holds the field around the guard so several blows in succession are gathered without breaking the stance.

name: Lacerating Hack
description: Lets the gathered force spill out of the hollow in one heavy drop onto the nearest opponent.

name: Mighty Bulkblade
description: Draws the whole force of a great blow into the held field and returns it in a single field-weighted cleave.

name: Veritynub
description: Seats the leg stream and the blade stream together in the chest, feeling them run in parallel.

name: Mightwhack
description: Lands the foot and the falchion at the same moment, so the cut carries the body's full weight.

name: Wedgetip Tenacity
description: Holds the blade high and the free palm up over the spine, a double guard against heavy blows.

name: Clipedge Mettle
description: Links a parry to a step so the blow is turned just as the body leaves its line.

name: Unsparing Hack
description: Beats two heavy hacks on alternating streams so neither the blade nor the legs tire.

name: Falchhilt Vitality
description: Links the field of the legs to the field of the blade, so power runs freely between them.

name: Sanguine Heavyback
description: Cuts down two parallel lines in succession, leaving the opponent no safe space between.

name: Gust Weightbelly
description: Holds a parry on both streams at once so a heavy cut is turned without the arm giving way.

name: Silt Cleft
description: Steps through the opponent's reach on the leg stream while the blade stream holds the guard.

name: Corroding Hash
description: Releases both streams together into the fall of the falchion, so the chop lands with the full field.

name: Slag Hash
description: Sweeps the falchion on both tracks in a wide arc that reaches all those inside the blade's circuit.

name: Immobilizing Chopblade
description: Drops two parallel cuts onto the opponent's blade, breaking the guard at the point of its weakest hold.

name: Booming Iron Cleaverbelly
description: Joins the legs, the blade and the field in one falling cleave that does not slow for a guard.

name: Unrelenting Thickspine
description: Stands as water about to return to its bed, the blade low and the weight easy.

name: Hackwrath
description: Stoops to the side and chops, the first of the paired cuts of the manual.

name: Lacerating Chunk
description: Mirrors the stoop-side chop on the opposite flank, returning along the opposite bank.

name: Torrential Bulkblade
description: Steps out with one foot and back with the other, pairing each advance with its return.

name: Torrent Chopblade
description: Parries on one side and then on the other with the same blade, mirroring the motion.

name: Might Weightbelly
description: Strikes first from above in a hawk's stoop and then from low in a river's return.

name: Might Hack
description: Crosses behind the opponent on the return of the second cut, ending on the open side.

name: Might Nubtip
description: Cleaves down on one side and mirrors the cleave on the other with the field carrying between.

name: Bulkblade Spine
description: Returns along the opponent's blade like a river to its bed and binds it down with the falchion's weight.

name: Devastating Whack
description: Lands a stoop and its returning cut in a single unbroken motion through the opponent's guard, both strokes carrying the field.

name: Thorn Thickspine
description: Holds the falchion upright before the face in the court salute, which doubles as a guard.

name: Tempered Heavyback
description: Opens the bout with a measured chop that tests the opponent's guard without committing the body.

name: Ghosting Falchhilt
description: Withdraws a pace on the count of the court, keeping the blade across the line.

name: Nubtipvalor
description: Runs through three parries in the prescribed order, each leaving the blade placed for the next.

name: Nubtipscourge
description: Delivers a ranked series of chops from high to low, each one heavier than the last.

name: Evergreen Cleaverbelly
description: Steadies the field to the cadence of the series so that the guard never wavers between strokes.

name: Nubtipvortex
description: Lengthens the step by a hand's breadth on the field's pull, extending the chop's range.

name: Wedgetip Devastation
description: Counters with the cut the order of the series names for the opponent's last move.

name: Merciless Hash
description: Cleaves along the court's ordered line with qi gathered at each stage of the series.

name: Rampaging Hew
description: Runs the whole ranked series without break to press the opponent into an unbroken defense.

name: Titanic Chunk
description: Releases the field gathered through the series in a great cut that reaches every opponent inside the falchion's span.

name: Veritynubtip
description: Stands with the falchion low and reads the wind on the skin to find the opponent's bearing.

name: Cleft Scourge
description: Chops once after speaking the short oath of the school, the breath and cut landing together.

name: Gust Nubtip
description: Advances with the wind at the back, each step timed to a gust.

name: Murknubtip
description: Leans into a headwind of blows and blocks them with the flat, giving no ground.

name: Booming Whack
description: Chains hacks in the uneven beat of gusts, so the opponent cannot time a counter.

name: Invincible Nubtip
description: Holds the field in the shape of a bearing wind around the blade so cuts slide aside.

name: Devastating Cleaverbelly
description: Hacks upward under the guard on a gust of field and lifts the opponent's arm away.

name: Phantom Clipedge
description: Pivots on the sworn bearing and shifts the body a quarter turn around the heavy blade.

name: Iron Hew
description: Rides a surge of the field into a cleave that falls with a gale's push behind it.

name: Indomitable Heavyback
description: Holds the heavy edge against a rush of blows with the field spread like wind round a rock.

name: Glint Falchhilt
description: Concentrates the field on the point and chops through armor with a sound like wind through a gap.

name: Mighthash
description: Falls from the oath's bearing with a gale of field behind the falchion, cleaving through guard and body.

name: Obdurate Clipedge
description: Stands level and square as on open plateau ground, with the falchion hanging at the ready.

name: Hewhavoc
description: Drops the blade with the weight of the sworn word settled behind the cut.

name: Ghosting Hew
description: Retreats along the edge of the ground with the blade covering the open side.

name: Unconquered Bulkblade
description: Parries without moving the feet, as if rooted, sending the blow wide with a turn of the flat.

name: Hashscourge
description: Drives hacks in a series bound to the words of the oath, each a measured step longer.

name: Wedgetip Spine
description: Roots the qi field in the ground through the feet so the guard cannot be pushed out of line.

name: Grievous Hack
description: Falls with every breath of the oath gathered in the falchion's edge.

name: Chopblade Tenacity
description: Holds the guard through an assault of any length, the field settled as the plateau under the feet.

name: Nova Thickspine
description: Seals the oath into the falchion's edge and drives the cut through any guard that is not fully field-hardened.

name: Remnant Weightbelly
description: Takes a bearing on the opponent and notes the way the wind will push the first cut.

name: Rampaging Cleft
description: Hacks as the wind turns, the cut landing from a quarter the opponent was not watching.

name: Torrent Cleft
description: Steps without changing the bearing so the blade stays pointed along the same line.

name: Murk Chopblade
description: Scours the opponent's blade across the whole flat in a turning parry that steals its line.

name: Rumble Thickspine
description: Chains cuts down one held bearing, each strike a hand's breadth lower than the one before.

name: Gust Cleaverbelly
description: Rolls the field around the blade in a turn so a blow is thrown past the body.

name: Sanguine Hew
description: Cuts across the opponent's line like a crosswind, striking the exposed flank.

name: Might Chunk
description: Breaks the opponent's bearing by pivoting around the heavy blade and cutting from the new side.

name: Blazechunk
description: Rolls the cleave through a full turn so it gathers speed and lands with a gale's weight.

name: Rumblehack
description: Tears the guard open with a turning blow that leaves the opponent's weapon swinging wide.

name: Blazestump
description: Spins the falchion in a whirl that sweeps all opponents within its reach.

name: Cleftwrath
description: Holds the bearing through an opponent's whole feint and cuts only when the true line opens.

name: Gnashing Tempered Wedgetip
description: Releases the whole gathered field into one turning cleave that lands with the weight of a gale.

name: Nubtipmettle
description: Stands on a straight line drawn between the feet and holds the blade across it.

name: Torrent Bulkblade
description: Parries any cut that crosses the line and turns it back across the opponent's own body.

name: Weightbelly Reckoning
description: Answers each crossing with a cut that follows the oath line back at the opponent.

name: Unseen Clipedge
description: Steps back along the same line, giving up distance but not the line itself.

name: Chunk Durance
description: Presses the opposing blade down the oath line at the moment of the counter, breaking its rhythm.

name: Aegis Falchhilt
description: Stakes the field along the line so an attack crossing it meets resistance.

name: Blazehack
description: Returns a heavy hack along the same line as the opponent's failed cut.

name: Equipoise Heavyback
description: Breaks an assault on the oath line with a parry backed by the whole field and a chop in return.

name: Vengeful Whack
description: Presses forward along the line in unbroken cuts that push the opponent back from the oath line.

name: Devastating Hew Scourge
description: Answers the opponent's committed strike with a falchion cut that crosses it and carries the whole field through.

name: Hoarfrost Nubtip
description: Stands near the edge of the plateau, the wind at the shoulder and the blade held low.

name: Whackruin
description: Hacks along the rim of the ground, cutting at the foot closest to the drop.

name: Torrent Hash
description: Sidesteps along the lip of the ground and leaves the opponent facing the drop.

name: Equipoise Nubtip
description: Knocks a cut upward with the flat, like a gust rising up a cliff face.

name: Tempered Hew
description: Presses the opponent toward the edge with two paired hacks, one from each side.

name: Intent Thickspine
description: Lifts the edge on the rising wind of the field and gives the next cut a lighter, faster fall.

name: Vanishing Chopblade
description: Turns suddenly at the plateau's edge, sending the opponent's rush past with nowhere to go.

name: Blazehash
description: Presses a cleave down along the cliff wind so it lands with the added weight of the gust.

name: Vengeful Hash
description: Cleaves along the rim in a long stroke that carries the field out past the plateau's edge.

name: Charter Whack
description: Drives hack after hack toward the plateau's edge until the opponent is pressed against the drop.

name: Ferocious Wedgetip
description: Falls from above with the plateau wind behind the blade, the stroke carrying the opponent over the edge.

name: Thornnub
description: Holds the stance tightly with the field kept close, saving the strength for the cut.

name: Rampaging Weightbelly
description: Coils the wrist back and releases it into a short chop with a sharp exhale.

name: Might Heavyback
description: Walks a narrow line of footing with the falchion held close, giving the opponent no opening.

name: Adamantine Clipedge
description: Closes the blade against the body in a parry that gives the attacker nothing to hit.

name: Booming Chunk
description: Gates each hack behind a breath so the stroke comes at an unpredictable moment.

name: Daybreak Cleaverbelly
description: Compresses the field around the blade until it presses against the steel.

name: Nubtipwrath
description: Slices short and hard from the compressed field so the cut lands before it can be seen.

name: Torrential Cleft
description: Steps inside the opponent's reach with the field tightly bound, ready to burst.

name: Nubwrath
description: Releases the compressed field in a chop that strikes harder than the arm's own power allows.

name: Guststump
description: Bursts the bound field out from the guard to throw an attacking blade wide.

name: Fastening Falchhilt
description: Closes the field on the opposing weapon and holds it still against the falchion's spine.

name: Daybreak Wedgetip
description: Lets the held field go in a single ring around the falchion, cutting all inside the blade's span.

name: Chopblade Valor
description: Holds a stance aimed at the target from far off, the falchion hanging low at the side.

name: Stumpvortex
description: Walks along the held bearing in measured steps, closing a long distance without altering the aim.

name: Mightstump
description: Raises the falchion slowly for the chop so the opponent watches the blade rather than the feet.

name: Unconquered Clipedge
description: Blocks with the flat at the edge of the falchion's reach, keeping the opponent at the far end of the bearing.

name: Rumble Whack
description: Hacks twice down the held line with no change of aim, the second cut finishing the first.

name: Elevating Bulkblade
description: Reads the opponent's field with an unwavering gaze and marks the moment its guard drops.

name: Hackhavoc
description: Cleaves down the full length of the held bearing with the field gathered from the long approach.

name: Silt Hew
description: Drives across the last stretch of the bearing in a single bound, the falchion already falling.

name: Lacerating Weightbelly
description: Lets one great cleave fall from the long bearing, the field gathered across the whole approach driving it through all guards.
